## Change

What changes, and which issue or user need does it address?

## Verification

List commands run and results. Explicitly identify skipped database tests or untested environments.

## Authorization and compatibility

Describe any change to access decisions, whole-trace behavior, revocation, SQL, API/cursor formats,
or migrations. Write "not affected" when appropriate.

## Checklist

- [ ] This is a focused change; new features were discussed first.
- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior and relevant failure paths.
- [ ] Documentation and known limitations match the implementation.
- [ ] No secrets, production traces, or private customer information are included.
- [ ] I have the right to submit this contribution under the project's license.

For suspected vulnerabilities, use SECURITY.md instead of a public PR.
